title: Rasane zulm me nanhi si kalaai hogi
body:
Rasane zulm me nanhi si kalaai hogi
mujrai kaise sakina ko kal aai hogi
<<DIVIDER>>
naujawaa'n ne jo sinaa'n seene pa khaai hogi
mujrai qaime se zainab nikal aai hogi
<<DIVIDER>>
shabe aashoor ye aati thi sadaae zahra
sub'ha ko mere bhare ghar ki safaai hogi
<<DIVIDER>>
bibiyaa'n kehti thi ye raat ghaneemat jaano
kal to ek jaan pe laakho'n ki chadhaai hogi
<<DIVIDER>>
naatawaa'n dekh ke abid ko ye bole rehgeer
haaye kisne ise zanjeer pinhaayi hogi
